title: Are Remote Jobs Dead? I Applied to 1,000 to Find Out.
description:
I don't even need a job, I just wanted to prove that fully-remote jobs still exist. You likely just have to apply a lot more than you think.

Video contents: 
00:00 Thumbnail Callback
00:25 Two Batches 
01:13 Portugal Ruined?
03:42 Day 2 
04:52 Day 3. Wish Carefully
06:32 Day 4
07:16 Day 5 
09:19 Day 6 
10:36 Final Day 

Prompt to have ChatGPT edit resume for a job description:
I’m applying to this job, and I want you to act like a resume optimization expert and an applicant tracking system (ATS) bot reviewer.

Here is the job description:
[PASTE JOB DESCRIPTION]

Here is my current resume:
[PASTE RESUME]

Your task:

Analyze the job description and identify the most important keywords, required skills, and role priorities.

Match those elements to my experience, skills, and achievements in the resume.

Rewrite or rephrase bullet points in my resume to highlight the most relevant and high-impact experience for this job.

Ensure the resume sounds natural (not keyword-stuffed), passes ATS filters, and makes me look like the ideal candidate.

Maintain a professional tone, but feel free to make phrasing more results-driven or engaging where appropriate.

At the end, give me:

A tailored resume in plain text (ready to paste into an application).

A short summary (3–4 sentences) of what major changes you made and why.
